studies.population: One data-mining expert and one biomedical expert, each with over 15 years experience.
tasks: Four analytic task sets after demonstration and repeated learning task.
studies.results: RTLX 55 and 46.7; SUS 85 and 87.5. One participant mainly used the chord view and misinterpreted an item-frequency task.
limitations: Two-expert formative sample; no alternative-system comparison; high SUS does not establish causal effectiveness.
studies.design: ARViz qualitative expert evaluation; Single interface, supervised learning followed by independent tasks.
